name: @lightspeedwp/release-skill
description: Comprehensive release management skill for WordPress block plugins and themes
author: LightSpeedWP Release Team

scripts.lint: npm run lint:markdown && npm run lint:json && npm run lint:yaml
scripts.lint:yaml: command -v yamllint >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'yamllint is not installed (pip install yamllint); YAML lint was NOT run' >&2; exit 1; }; files=$(find .lefthook.yml .github -type f \( -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.yaml' \) 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$files" ]; then echo 'No YAML files found; nothing was linted'; exit 0; fi; yamllint $files
scripts.docs:build: echo 'Documentation is markdown-based. No build needed.'
scripts.docs:validate: npm run lint && npm run validate:structure
